subject.title: Feishu Bitable write operations return 400 after bot/app replacement

question: Should Feishu Bitable table-level 400s after bot/app replacement be handled as app-credential setup/permission diagnostics, or should the plugin add new user-auth/token behavior for these Bitable operations?
rationale: Current source proves the app-credential path, but the live Feishu error payload needed to distinguish setup, permission, account routing, and auth-mode causes is missing; user-token support would be a new auth surface.

options.title: Collect live Feishu error first
options.body: Ask for the exact Feishu response body/code/log_id and app/resource setup details before choosing between diagnostics and new auth behavior.

options.title: Treat as setup diagnostics
options.body: Keep Bitable tools on bot app credentials and improve permission, publication, scope, and resource-sharing diagnostics once the live error confirms that cause.

options.title: Design user-token support
options.body: Sponsor a Feishu Bitable user-auth design only if live evidence shows table-level operations cannot be made reliable with bot app credentials.

recommendation.title: Collect live Feishu error first
recommendation.body: Ask for the exact Feishu response body/code/log_id and app/resource setup details before choosing between diagnostics and new auth behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The Feishu plugin is documented as community maintained by this handle, and this decision is plugin-specific auth/product behavior.
